SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
Station, ____
Date ____ 19

REPORT

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE -
ARREST OF ALLEGED LEADER OF MOBILE UNITS IN TSUNGMING.

Made by D.S. FOWLER Forwarded by C.D.I. BRUBISTER
8200/27

Sir,

With reference to the statement of one, CHANG
TEH KONG (张德公), forwarded by the Japanese Gendarmerie,
in which it is asserted that the person detained by the
Municipal Police, KAU MAU NEU (高茂纽), is a leader of
mobile units in Tsungming, and also bears the mark of bullet
wounds, Kau Mau Neu was examined by the undersigned for such
marks.

On the front of his left thigh are two wounds,
the higher one being larger. He stated he received the injury
about five years ago (1932/3) whilst he was attacked on his
boat by robbers, near Tsungming, who fired at him. Persons
resident near his home know of the occurrence.

To substantiate or refute his statement as to the
period of time elapsed since receiving his injury, he was
escorted to the Police Hospital and examined by Dr. Kwoh on the
morning of the 14.1.39.

Dr. Kwoh stated that he could not pass any definite
opinion as to the age of the wounds, but they were definitely
more than three to four months old and may possibly be three
or four years old.

Also, the larger of the two scars had the appearance
of having become infected during the initial stages of healing
and if this was so, would account for it being larger and which
wound was entry and which exit was then a matter of conjecture.

Kau Mau Neu still persists in his denials in being
in anyway concerned in guerilla activities.

Yours obediently,
A.W. Fowler
D.S.329

D. C. (Special Branch).

报告

事由 关于进一步协助日本宪兵队——逮捕据称在崇明的流动部队头目。

由 D.S. FOWLER 呈报 经 C.D.I. BRUBISTER 转呈
8200/27

先生：

关于日本宪兵队转来的一份陈述，陈述人为 CHANG TEH KONG（张德公），其中声称被工部局警务处拘留的人员 KAU MAU NEU（高茂纽）是崇明岛流动部队的头目，且身上有枪弹伤痕，下述签署人对此人进行了检查以核实此类痕迹。

在其左大腿前侧有两处伤口，较高的一处较大。他称约在五年前（1932/3年），他在崇明附近遭到抢劫其船只的匪徒袭击，匪徒向他开枪，他因此受伤。居住在他家附近的人都知道此事。

为了证实或反驳他关于受伤后经过时间的说法，他于1939年1月14日上午被护送至警察医院，由郭医生（Dr. Kwoh）进行检查。

郭医生表示，他无法对伤口的确切年限发表明确意见，但这些伤口肯定已超过三至四个月，可能有三年或四年之久。

此外，两处疤痕中较大的一处呈现出在愈合初期发生感染的迹象，如果确实如此，就能解释其较大的原因，而哪一处是入口、哪一处是出口则纯属推测。

Kau Mau Neu 仍然坚持否认他与游击活动有任何关联。

您忠顺的仆人，
A.W. Fowler
D.S.329

D. C.（特务科）。

REPORT

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE re ARREST OF ALLEGED
LEADER OF MOBILE UNITS IN TSUNGTING.

Made by D.S. FOSTER Forwarded by D.I. GLOVER.

Sir,

The arrested male, KAU MAU HSU (〔此处转录不清〕), has
been closely interrogated by C.D.S.115 and the undersigned
during his period of detention, but nothing which would
substantiate the contention of the Japanese Gendarmerie that
he is in anyway concerned in guerilla activities etc. has
transpired.

A statement ( copy attached ) has been taken
from him in which he avers the Gendarmerie informer was
possibly one of a number of bandits, who were arrested by
residents of Ah Woo Soo, Kau Jao, Pootung, for depredations
on that populace. This, of course, might possibly be reprisal
for having been identified by the informer.

D.S. Mitsushima, attached to the S.P.O. informed
the undersigned that the Gendarmerie with their headquarters
at 94 Jessfield Road, still requested that the arrested man be
handed over to their jurisdiction.

D.S. Mitsushima, however, also informed the
undersigned that he had been apprised that the informer of the
Gendarmerie was not the person who laid the actual charge against
the arrested man, but another male who had been arrested in the
Central District under Japanese occupation, and had admitted
being a member of a mobile unit and that the now-arrested man
was the leader. The Gendarmerie had then contacted the informer
who stated he knew the whereabouts of the alleged leader and was
the reason the Gendarmerie requested assistance to visit Room 327
of the Central Hotel.

报告

事由 关于进一步协助日本宪兵队，涉及逮捕据称在崇明的流动部队头目。

由 D.S. FOSTER 呈报 经 D.I. GLOVER 转呈。

先生：

被捕男子 KAU MAU HSU（〔此处转录不清〕）在拘留期间受到 C.D.S.115 和下述签署人的严密审讯，但并未发现任何能证实日本宪兵队所称他参与游击活动等说法的情况。

已从他那里取得一份陈述（副本附后），他在陈述中断言，宪兵队的线人可能是被浦东高桥亚伍灶（Ah Woo Soo, Kau Jao, Pootung）居民逮捕的一伙匪徒之一，这些匪徒曾掠夺当地民众。这当然可能是因被线人指认而进行的报复。

隶属于特别调查科（S.P.O.）的 D.S. Mitsushima 告知下述签署人，总部设在极司菲尔路94号（Jessfield Road）的宪兵队仍要求将被捕男子移交给他们管辖。

然而，D.S. Mitsushima 也告知下述签署人，他获悉宪兵队的线人并非实际指控被捕男子的人，而是另一名在日军占领下的中区被捕的男子，该男子承认自己是流动部队成员，并称现在被捕的男子是头目。随后宪兵队联系了线人，线人称他知道据称头目的下落，这也是宪兵队请求协助前往中央饭店327房间的原因。

To confirm the assertion of the arrested male that he had
visited the Tung de Academiae Medical, Lane 67 House 1 Yates
Road re a disease from which he was suffering, he was accom-
panied by C.D.S. 115 and the undersigned on the morning of the
10-1-39 to that address.

Dr. Tau Kyn Sung ( 〔此处转录不清〕 ) verified from his records
the fact that the arrested man had first visited the laboratory
on the 2nd. January, 1939, for tests.

It was learned from D.S. Mitsushima of the S.P.O. that
the Gendarmerie were taking a statement from the man in their
custody in which he asserts the arrested male is the leader
of a mobile unit. It is learnt a copy of this statement will
be forwarded to the Municipal Police for information.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

FORM 40
3. 6M-11-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Kao Mau Nau ( 高 毛 囝 )
native of Tsungming taken by me C.D.S. 115
at C.B.H.Q. "C" 1 on the 8/1/39 and interpreted by Clerk Lsia

My name is Kao Mau Nau, age 28, native of Tsungming,
m/boatman, residing at Ah Woo Soo, Kau Jao, Pootung.
I am the owner of a boat. I was born in Sung Keh Tsung,
Tsungming and have never received any education. I removed
from Tsungming, to Pootung when I was 16 years of age. At the
age of 19 years my boat was hired to the Revenue Police of the
Salt Inspectorate in Lieu-ho for $24.00 per month, and I was
employed by them as a boatman. I received $6.00 wages each
month. One year later, I discontinued my job and started a
transportation business myself. I usually transport vegetables
from Tsungming to Shanghai or pigs from Kompo to Kau Jao,
Pootung.
At the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities, a number
of traitors robbed people in Ah Woo Soo, Kau Jao, Pootung.
In resistance, we arrested and prosecuted 12 of them before
the Magistrate of the Tsungming Islen City Government. I
think that one named Koo Woo Sung, at present an informer of
Japanese Military Police, is one of the traitors. He hates
me so he made a false accusation against me before the Japanese
authorities. On the 1-1-39 I came to Shanghai to attend a
doctor because I am ill and I reside in room 327 Central Hotel,
545 Canton Road.
I am not a soldier. I have no any connection with any
Anti-Japanese parties or criminal gangs.
This is my true statement.

Signed & Thumb-printed.
page_data.zh:
表格 40
3. 6M-11-35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下是 Kao Mau Nau（高毛囝）的陈述，他是崇明岛人，由我 C.D.S. 115 于1939年1月8日在总部刑事侦缉处“C”1室录取，由职员 Lsia 翻译。

我叫 Kao Mau Nau，28岁，崇明岛人，职业船夫，居住在浦东高桥亚伍灶（Ah Woo Soo, Kau Jao, Pootung）。
我拥有一艘船。我出生在崇明宋克宗（Sung Keh Tsung，音译），从未受过教育。我16岁时从崇明搬到浦东。19岁时，我的船以每月24.00美元的价格租给六河沟（Lieu-ho，音译）盐务稽核所的缉私警察，我被他们雇为船夫。我每月工资6.00美元。一年后，我辞去了工作，开始自己经营运输业务。我通常将蔬菜从崇明运到上海，或将猪从龚家路（Kompo，音译）运到浦东高桥。
中日敌对行动爆发时，一批汉奸在浦东高桥亚伍灶抢劫百姓。作为抵抗，我们逮捕了其中12人，并向崇明岛市政府地方法官提起诉讼。我认为目前担任日本军事警察线人的顾武松（Koo Woo Sung）就是那些汉奸之一。他恨我，所以在日本当局面前诬告我。1939年1月1日，我因病来到上海看病，住在广东路545号中央饭店327房间。
我不是军人。我与任何抗日党派或犯罪团伙没有任何联系。
这是我的真实陈述。

签名并按手印。

REPORT

Subject ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE. ARREST OF ALLEGED LEADER OF
MOBILE UNITS IN TSUNGMING.

Made by D.S. Fowler Forwarded by D.I. Glover.

Sir,

At 11 p.m. 6th January 1939, Sergeant Suzuki of the
Japanese Gendarmerie with headquarters at 94 Jessfield Road,
requested assistance to visit room 327 of the Central Hotel,
545 Canton Road, to effect the arrest of one Tung Mo-nu (湯毛囝)
who, according to information given them by one Koo Woo Sung
(顧武松), was a commander of a mobile unit on Tsungming
Island.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Mitsushima (S.P.O.),
C.D.S. 115 and the undersigned when, at 12-50 a.m. 7th January
room 327 of the Central Hotel was visited and two males were
found therein.

The Gendarmerie's informer pointed out one of the males
who gave his name as, Kau Mau Neu (高毛囝), 28, Tsungming,
M/boat master residing Ah Woo Tsoh (亞伍灶) Pootung. This
man emphatically denied being connected with mobile units or the
army. He stated he came to Shanghai on the 1st January together
with his friend Tseu Kyl Lang (周健郎), the other occupant
of the room, to receive medical attention for syphilis. To prove
this he produced a report of the Tung de Academiae Medicae,
No.1, Lane 67 Yates Road which stated that from tests made the
reaction was positive. The fact of him having visited the
laboratory will be verified later.

D. C. (Special Branch). However, the Gendarmerie in view of their information
received requested that he be detained. This was complied with.
Nothing of an incriminating nature was found in his possession.
He will be detained at C.I. pending further enquiries and
instructions regarding his disposal.

FILE
P.A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
D.S. 329.

报告

事由 协助日本宪兵队。逮捕据称在崇明的流动部队头目。

由 D.S. Fowler 呈报 经 D.I. Glover 转呈。

先生：

1939年1月6日晚上11点，总部设在极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队铃木警佐（Sergeant Suzuki）请求协助，前往广东路545号中央饭店327房间，以逮捕 Tung Mo-nu（汤毛囝），据顾武松（Koo Woo Sung）向他们提供的信息，此人是崇明岛上一支流动部队的指挥官。

特别调查科（S.P.O.）的 D.S. Mitsushima、C.D.S. 115 和下述签署人提供了协助，于1月7日凌晨12点50分探访了中央饭店327房间，发现里面有两名男子。

宪兵队的线人指出了其中一名男子，该男子自称 Kau Mau Neu（高毛囝），28岁，崇明人，职业船主，居住在浦东亚伍灶（Ah Woo Tsoh）。此人坚决否认与流动部队或军队有任何关联。他称他于1月1日与同住该房间的朋友 Tseu Kyl Lang（周健郎）一起来上海接受梅毒治疗。为了证明这一点，他出示了亚尔培路67弄1号同德医学院（Tung de Academiae Medicae）的一份报告，指出测试反应呈阳性。他就诊实验室的事实将在稍后核实。

D. C.（特务科）。然而，宪兵队鉴于所获信息，要求拘留他。这一要求已得到遵从。在他身上未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。他将暂时拘留在刑事侦缉处（C.I.），等待关于如何处置他的进一步查询和指示。

归档
致 D. C.（特务科）的私人助理
D.S. 329.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

ABDUCTION OF A MOBILE UNIT CAPTAIN

At 4 p.m. January 8, a motor car stopped in
front of the Central Hotel (中央大旅社), Canton Road,
and five or six men of middle age alighted, entered a
room of the hotel on the second floor and compelled
its occupant to board the car which then drove off.
As the employees of the hotel were about to make a report
to the Police, one Huang Chao-shing (黄兆兴), living
in the same room, stated that the man abducted was one
Tang Mou-an (汤卯安), captain of the third squad of
the mobile units on the border of Kiangsu and Chekiang.
This squad under Tang had a fight with Japanese soldiers
the other day outside Woosung. Huang added that he came
to Shanghai together with Tang two days ago to discuss
certain affairs and that he had escaped notice because
he was at the door at the time of Tang's abduction.
Huang then left for an unknown destination.
The management of the hotel later made a
report to the Police who are investigating the matter.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

流动部队队长被绑架

1月8日下午4时，一辆汽车停在广东路中央大旅社门前，五六个中年人下车，进入旅馆二楼的一个房间，强迫住客上车，随后驾车离去。正当旅馆员工准备向警方报案时，同住该房间的黄兆兴（Huang Chao-shing）称，被绑架者是汤卯安（Tang Mou-an），江苏和浙江边境流动部队第三小队队长。汤率领的这支小队前几天在吴淞外与日军发生过战斗。黄补充说，他两天前与汤一起来上海商讨某些事务，由于汤被绑架时他在门口，因此未被注意。黄随后前往一个未知的目的地。
旅馆管理层后来向警方报案，警方正在调查此事。

协助日本宪兵队。
1939年1月13日上午7点40分，I.S.I. Konovaloff
C.I. 会同 S.P.O. 的 J.A. Kitamura 向本局值班室警官报告，他们会同日本宪兵队下士官长 Shimomura 及另外两名成员，前往莫霍克路（Mohawk Road，音译）85弄12号，试图逮捕一名名叫张树道（Chang Su Tao）的中国男子，安徽人，据称居住在上述地址。
据报道，此人曾是此前在苏州附近活动的流动部队的小组长，他已抵达上海，但在上述地址实施逮捕的尝试未果。
已就所提供的协助出具了 C.I. 杂项报告 10/39，现转发本报告以供参考。
